name: ClipToCart – Shoppable Video, Product Video Slider & Story Bubbles for WooCommerce
author: cannyapps

sections.description:
Turn your store visitors into buyers with ClipToCart – Shoppable Video! 🚀

ClipToCart brings modern, interactive video shopping directly to your WooCommerce storefront. Easily upload high-definition product videos directly from your WordPress Media Library, tag one or multiple products from your store catalog, and display gorgeous video carousels and story bubble widgets with one-click AJAX Add to Cart.

Customers can watch your product demos, view real-time prices, and add items straight to their shopping cart without ever leaving or pausing the video!

🔥 Why Shoppable Video for WooCommerce?

  • 3x Higher Conversion Rates: Video content demonstrates your products in action, building instant buyer trust and eliminating hesitation.
  • Frictionless Shopping: Customers can buy directly inside the interactive video player via AJAX with zero page reloads.
  • Mobile-First Experience: Engineered specifically for mobile shoppers with intuitive touch gestures and vertical aspect ratios.

✨ Key Features

  • 🎬 WordPress Media Library Uploader: Upload your MP4, WebM, or Ogg videos effortlessly through WordPress Media or paste direct video links.
  • 🏷️ Multi-Product Tagging: Tag one or multiple WooCommerce products per video with live price, title, and image synchronization.
  • 🛒 Instant AJAX Add-to-Cart: Fast, seamless cart additions directly from the video overlay without interrupting playback.
  • 🎠 Responsive Carousel Slider: Showcase multiple shoppable videos together in a modern mobile-first slider using shortcode [shoppable_video layout="carousel"].
  • 🔘 Instagram-Style Story Bubbles: Showcase engaging circular video story bubbles with customizable border rings and autoplay.
  • 📱 Corner Floating Popup Widget: Engage shoppers with non-intrusive floating video popups on specific pages or store-wide.
  • ⚡ React-Powered Admin Dashboard: Manage video collections, product tags, and layouts with a blazing fast, intuitive React dashboard.
  • 🚀 Lightweight & High Performance: Clean vanilla JavaScript frontend with zero heavy third-party runtime dependencies.

🛍️ Perfect for Any WooCommerce Store:

  • Fashion & Apparel: Showcase models wearing outfits in motion.
  • Beauty & Skincare: Demonstrate makeup tutorials, textures, and glow routines.
  • Electronics & Gadgets: Show unboxings, build quality, and real-life features.
  • Home Decor & Furniture: Display 360-degree spatial views and craftsmanship.
  • Jewelry & Luxury Goods: Highlight sparkle, close-up details, and authenticity.

🛠️ Shortcode Usage

Embed your shoppable videos anywhere with easy-to-use shortcodes:

  • Display All Published Shoppable Videos:
    [shoppable_video]

  • Carousel Slider Layout:
    [shoppable_video layout=”carousel”]

  • Story Bubble Layout:
    [shoppable_video layout=”story”]

  • Specific Video Collection by ID:
    [shoppable_video id=”123″]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cliptocart-shoppable-video folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins dashboard (Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to ClipToCart in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  5. Upload your product video, tag products from your catalog, and publish!
  6. Copy the generated shortcode (e.g. [shoppable_video]) and paste it into any page, post, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. ClipToCart requires WooCommerce so that it can search your product catalog, fetch real-time prices, and handle seamless AJAX Add-to-Cart.

Which video formats can I upload?

You can upload any standard web video format supported by WordPress, including MP4, WebM, and Ogg. You can also enter direct URLs to self-hosted video files.

What is the recommended video resolution and aspect ratio?

For the best mobile shopping experience, we recommend vertical videos with a 9:16 aspect ratio (1080×1920 or 720×1280) and compressed MP4 format.

Can I tag multiple products in a single video?

Yes! You can tag multiple products in each video. When shoppers view the video, they will see an interactive slider allowing them to browse and buy all tagged items.

Does this work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes! ClipToCart works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg block editor, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, or any theme that supports shortcodes.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. ClipToCart is built with performance in mind. The frontend scripts are ultra-lightweight and optimized for fast loading and smooth 60fps animations.
